text: These are the facts about a UK takeaway, set by its owner for an AI phone receptionist demo.
Name: Ember & Bun. Style: Smash burgers, wings and loaded fries. Town: Kirkhill, 9 Forge Street, Kirkhill NG1 (example).
Hours: Tuesday to Thursday and Sunday: 4pm till 10:30pm. Friday and Saturday: 4pm till midnight. Closed Mondays.
Collection: yes. Delivery to NG1 and NG2 is £3, with a £15 minimum; to NG3, £4 with a £20 minimum. Also on Deliveroo, Uber Eats.
Orders are paid by card on the phone.
All our meat is halal. We cook in a shared kitchen and fryers, so we can't rule out traces of any allergen.

Parking: Street parking only. Bags: Your food comes in a paper bag, at no charge. Tips: Tips for the drivers are welcome, and they keep all of them. Jobs: We're often looking for drivers and kitchen staff: ask for the manager in the shop. Offers: Tuesdays: two Burger meals for £16, collection only.

Menu: Burgers: Classic beef burger, Cheeseburger, Double cheeseburger, Crispy chicken burger, Firebird spicy burger, Veggie burger; Fried chicken: Six hot wings, Three chicken strips, Popcorn chicken, Two pieces of chicken, Family bucket; Wraps: Chicken wrap, Spicy chicken wrap, Halloumi wrap; Pizzas: Margherita, Pepperoni, BBQ chicken, Hot and spicy, Veggie supreme; Sides: Fries, Cheesy fries, Onion rings, Coleslaw, Corn on the cob, Garlic bread; Drinks: Coca-Cola, Diet Coke, Fanta Orange, Sprite, Bottled water; Desserts: Chocolate brownie, Cookie dough, Vanilla ice cream tub.
Meal deals: Burger meal, Chicken box.
Write the ten questions callers most often ask a takeaway like this that the facts above answer, each with a short spoken answer (one or two sentences, friendly, British English).

Use only these facts. Where the facts do not cover something, leave that question out rather than guess. No questions about taking orders for collection or delivery, and saying how long an order will be themselves; the receptionist handles those.
